connector.name: osu! MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server exposing the osu! API v2: player stats, scores, beatmap search, rankings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package osu-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the osyanne account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OSU_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Numeric Client ID from your osu! OAuth application (https://osu.ppy.sh/home/account/edit).

env.name: OSU_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client Secret from the same osu! OAuth application.
